reason: I pay for nothing right now. Everything I need for placement prep is on YouTube and GeeksforGeeks for free, and I already use a free AI chatbot for doubts, so I don't see why I'd start paying INR 299 a month.
objection: The free resources cover the same DSA and DBMS topics, so the mentor and resume checks would have to prove they do something those don't.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the resume check catch a real problem in my own resume that I could not find myself, before I am asked to pay.
